summary: Responder chain, key equivalents, menus, cursor shapes, gesture recognizers, scroll wheel and tracking-area models, typed drag and drop, dock badge, progress and menu, and an AT-SPI accessibility bridge exist. Wheel, hover and two-finger magnify and rotate events do not reach apps yet, the view kit has no drag and drop, and Touch Bar is Apple-only.

features.apple: NSEvent, NSResponder, key events, tracking areas, trackpad touches
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 17 tests. responder chain, key combos and focus loop exist; app input is only Down/Move/Up/Cancel, no wheel, hover, tracking areas or nextKeyView (docs/bifrost-ui.md ~line 870)

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/menu.rs, springboard/ui/src/cursor.rs, springboard/ui/src/cursor_art.rs, springboard/sdk/src/cursor_service.rs, springboard/sdk/src/dock_tile.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs, springboard/sdk/src/status_item.rs, springboard/src/shell/desktop_dock.rs
features.note: menu bar, validation, key equivalents, status items, Dock badge (Ctx::set_badge), Dock progress bar and the app's Dock menu items (sdk dock_tile set_menu, rendered in desktop_bar.rs Menu::Dock) exist. Cursor shapes (ui::cursor::Kind: frameResize, columnResize, rowResize, move, rotate, zoom, disappearingItem, operationNotAllowed) are pushed by the SDK cursor service; the layered outline and fill art in cursor_art.rs is not yet drawn by the compositor. built on parity/team-k-appkit-user-interactions; not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: NSGestureRecognizer and subclasses (click, pan, magnification, rotation, press)
features.note: recognizer state machines (tap, pan, long press, magnify, rotate) exist as pure models; ui::trackpad_gesture runs the pinch and the rotation together on one two-finger touch and returns Began, Changed and Ended events in order. The compositor does not yet send two-finger touches to apps. built on parity/team-k-appkit-user-interactions; not yet verified on Midget.

typed drag and drop between apps (docs/bifrost-ui.md section 508). The drag session state machine (ui::drag_session: Entered, Updated, Exited, Perform, Conclude, one operation from the source mask) is used by the SDK transfer path; the view kit itself has no drag and drop, so views need app glue. built on parity/team-k-appkit-user-interactions; not yet verified on Midget.

AT-SPI2 bridge with label/title/help, caret and selection, announcements. ui::ax records parent links per frame (AxLink, children_of, parent_of, index_in_parent, accessibilityChildren-style), but the AT-SPI bridge does not read them yet, so nodes are reported flat. built on parity/team-k-appkit-user-interactions; not yet verified on Midget.

features.apple: NSPasteboard(name:), .general, .drag, .find, clearContents, writeObjects, pasteboardItems, availableType(from:), canReadItem, changeCount
features.note: named boards (app-local except general), multiple items, UTType-conforming reads; the shell wire is flat so only the first item of the general board reaches the shell; needs a Midget check

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 2 tests (earlier part). Since merged with the Transferable pasteboard (host tests only): an item also holds promised types (setDataProvider), converts to and from the wire item; needs a Midget check

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests (earlier part). Since merged with the Transferable pasteboard (host tests only): one PasteboardItem and NativePasteboard::declare_types replace the separate PromiseBoard; lazy in-process promised data, type owners and file promises; not yet carried over the wire to other apps

gaps: Scroll wheel, hover (tracking-area) and two-finger magnify and rotate events are not delivered to apps: the app input path carries only Down, Move, Up and Cancel, so a ToApp variant is needed
Cursor art (cursor_art.rs) is not yet drawn by the compositor; the SDK cursor service pushes shapes that the shell does not show with the outline and fill colour setting yet
Dock tile content beyond the progress bar (a custom contentView)
Drag and drop inside the retained view kit (ui::drag_session is used by the SDK transfer path only)
Nested accessibility tree nodes in the AT-SPI bridge (ui::ax already keeps the parent links)
